# SynapseKit

> Async-native Python framework for building LLM-powered applications: RAG pipelines, agents, graph workflows, guardrails, and agent federation. 2 hard dependencies. Apache 2.0.

## Overview

SynapseKit is an open-source Python library for engineers who want to ship LLM-powered features without inheriting a large dependency tree or opaque abstractions. It is a lightweight alternative to LangChain and LlamaIndex: build production RAG apps, tool-using agents, and DAG-based graph workflows with 2 hard dependencies and a plain-Python, no-hidden-chains API.

- Version: 2.0.1
- License: Apache 2.0
- Language: Python 3.11+
- Hard dependencies: 2 (numpy, rank-bm25)
- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseKit/SynapseKit
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/synapsekit/
- Docs: https://synapsekit.github.io/synapsekit-docs/
- Website: https://synapse-kit.com
- Discord: https://discord.gg/PSuAXHRywJ

## Key Capabilities

- **46 LLM providers** behind one `BaseLLM` interface, auto-detected from the model name (`gpt-4o` -> OpenAI, `claude-*` -> Anthropic, `gemini-*` -> Google). OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, Hugging Face, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, DeepSeek, Together AI, OpenRouter, Fireworks, Cerebras, and more.
- **32 vector stores** behind one `VectorStore` interface: Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, LanceDB, pgvector, Redis, MongoDB Atlas, SQLiteVec, FAISS, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Turbopuffer, Azure AI Search, Vertex AI Vector Search, DeepLake, and a zero-dependency `InMemoryVectorStore`.
- **83 data loaders** returning `list[Document]` with a sync `.load()` and async `.aload()`: PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, Parquet, S3, Azure Blob, GCS, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, BigQuery, YouTube, Sitemap, Airtable, Notion, Confluence, Jira, Slack, GitHub, and audio/video via Whisper.
- **56 built-in agent tools** implementing `BaseTool`, plus a `@tool` decorator to turn any plain Python function (sync or async) into a tool.
- **9 embeddings and reranker providers** behind a `BaseEmbeddings` contract and a `Reranker` interface (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage, Jina, Gemini, Mistral, Mixedbread, Hugging Face, plus local ONNX).
- **10 agent memory backends**: SQLite, Redis, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Firestore, Cosmos DB, Cassandra, Memcached, in-memory.
- **RAG pipelines**: `RAG` facade with `.add()`, `.ask()`, `.stream()`, hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, reranking, conversation memory, token tracing, and an optional graph store for hybrid vector + knowledge-graph retrieval.
- **Agents**: ReAct loop (any LLM) and native function calling (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral) via the `agent()` factory or `ReActAgent`/`FunctionCallingAgent`. `ReasoningAgent` auto-routes between a fast model and a reasoning model (o1/o3, Claude thinking, DeepSeek R1, Qwen QwQ).
- **Graph workflows**: `StateGraph` builder for DAG-based async pipelines with conditional routing, typed state, fan-out/fan-in, SSE streaming, human-in-the-loop interrupts, checkpointing, and Mermaid export.
- **Guardrails**: `GuardedLLM` policy middleware wrapping any `BaseLLM`, with block/redact/flag/require-human modes, prompt-injection and jailbreak input guards, PII-redaction and toxicity/citation output guards, and HIPAA/GDPR/PCI-DSS rulepacks.
- **Verifiable agents**: signed, hash-chained audit trails (Ed25519, pluggable KMS/BYOK) with a standalone verifier returning `MATCH` / `DRIFT` / `UNVERIFIABLE`.
- **AgentSwarm and AgentFederation**: market-based multi-agent routing (sealed-bid, Vickrey, English, coalition auctions) with reputation learning, plus a simpler in-memory or Redis agent registry.
- **SynapseKit Live**: a zero-dependency, real-time local dashboard streaming every LLM call, tool call, retrieval, DB write, knowledge-graph update, cost, and human approval.
- **Evaluation**: `@eval_case` suites, `RAGEvaluator`, `PromptOptimizer`, `ContinuousTrainer`, and EvalCI, a free GitHub Action that runs eval suites on every PR and blocks merge on quality regression.
- **Async-native and streaming-first** throughout, with sync wrappers for scripts and notebooks.

## Architecture

SynapseKit is structured as a collection of composable modules:

- `synapsekit.llm` -- 46 LLM provider adapters, all implementing `BaseLLM`
- `synapsekit.rag` -- `RAG` facade and `RAGPipeline`
- `synapsekit.retrieval` -- vector stores, rerankers, and retrieval strategies (hybrid, HyDE, RAG-fusion, property-graph, world-model)
- `synapsekit.loaders` -- 83 document loaders
- `synapsekit.embeddings` -- embeddings and reranker providers
- `synapsekit.agents` -- `agent()` factory, `ReActAgent`, `FunctionCallingAgent`, `AgentSwarm`, `AgentFederation`, `AgentRegistry`, 56 built-in tools, `@tool` decorator
- `synapsekit.graph` -- `StateGraph` DAG workflow engine, checkpointers, human-in-the-loop interrupts
- `synapsekit.guardrails` -- `GuardedLLM`, `GuardrailPolicy`, input/output guards, compliance rulepacks
- `synapsekit.audit` -- `VerifiableAgent`, signed hash-chained audit trails, `verify()`
- `synapsekit.memory` -- `AgentMemory`, `LivingMemory`, 10 persistence backends
- `synapsekit.symbolic` -- `NeuroSymbolicAgent` with Z3/SymPy/MiniZinc/Prolog backends
- `synapsekit.evaluation` -- `eval_case`, `RAGEvaluator`, `PromptOptimizer`
- `synapsekit.training` -- `ContinuousTrainer`, A/B routing, rollout guards
- `synapsekit.observability` -- `PrometheusMetrics`, cost tracking, tracing
- `synapsekit.live` -- SynapseKit Live real-time dashboard

## Installation

```
pip install synapsekit[openai]
```

Optional extras (install only what you use):
- `pip install synapsekit[anthropic]` -- Anthropic + prompt caching
- `pip install synapsekit[chroma]` / `[pinecone]` / `[qdrant]` -- vector stores
- `pip install synapsekit[browser]` -- Playwright browser tool
- `pip install synapsekit[observe]` -- OpenTelemetry + Prometheus metrics
- `pip install synapsekit[all]` -- everything

Docker: `docker pull ghcr.io/synapsekit/synapsekit:latest` (core) or `:all` (batteries-included), published automatically on every release.

Full installation guide: https://synapsekit.github.io/synapsekit-docs/docs/getting-started/installation

## Comparison

| Feature | SynapseKit | LangChain | LlamaIndex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hard dependencies | 2 | 50+ | 20+ |
| Install size | ~5 MB | ~200 MB+ | ~100 MB+ |
| Async-native | Default | Partial | Partial |
| LLM providers | 46 | 38+ | 20+ |
| Vector stores | 32 | 15+ | 15+ |
| Data loaders | 83 | 100+ | 50+ |
| Agent tools | 56 built-in | Community plugins | Community plugins |
| Graph workflows | Built-in | LangGraph (separate package) | No |
| Agent federation / swarm | Built-in, market-based | No | No |
| Guardrails | Built-in, policy middleware | No | No |
| Verifiable audit trails | Signed, hash-chained | No | No |
| Cost tracking | Built-in | LangSmith (SaaS) | No |
| Evaluation / EvalCI | CLI + free GitHub Action | LangSmith (SaaS) | Built-in |
| Observability | Prometheus + Grafana | No | No |
| License | Apache 2.0 | MIT | MIT |

LangChain has more raw integrations and more tutorials. SynapseKit optimizes for a different problem: shipping, debugging, and maintaining an LLM feature in production, where readable code, predictable async behavior, and no surprise SaaS bills actually matter.
